jobs.description:
**Ready to Ride?**
  

At VoroMotors, your journey doesn’t start with a scooter — it starts with a mission. We move fast, we break limits (not rules), and we build cool things with even cooler people. Whether you're in LA or leading from across the globe, you’ll get a front\-row seat to hyper\-growth, electric innovation, and wild ideas that actually get executed. This isn’t a “coast and chill” kind of place — it’s where top performers come to *ride harder, build smarter,* and leave their mark. Check out below for the roles that we are currently hiring.


  
Location: LA or Remote (PST overlap required) \- Can be overseas, as long as you can show clearly you have run teams remotely.
Type: Full\-Time
Comp: Base Salary \+ Bonus tied to execution
What This Role Is Really About
We don’t need someone to just “oversee” operations. We need a results\-driven executor who gets into the trenches, finds weak points, and fixes them — fast. If you can’t get your hands dirty, this isn’t the job for you.
You’ll be the central nervous system across inventory, logistics, customer service, fulfillment, and process improvement. When something breaks, you don’t just notice — you own it, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again.
Your Responsibilities
Oversee all ops functions: fulfillment, inventory flow, customer escalations, logistics
Spot bottlenecks in real time — and eliminate them before they turn into fires
Manage KPIs across departments and hold teams accountable (no passengers)
Coordinate launches and new product rollouts with inventory and marketing
Ensure SOPs are being followed (and updated when broken)
Escalate only when you’ve tried solving it yourself
What You Need to Succeed
3\+ years in operations, logistics, or supply chain (preferably in e\-comm or DTC)
Experience running remote or cross\-functional teams
Super strong with systems: spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
Detail\-oriented to a fault — you catch the small stuff before it becomes big stuff
Bias for action. You don’t ask “who’s fixing this?” — you are.
What We Don’t Want
Delegators with no follow\-up
People who can’t track tasks or drop balls in chaos
You let problems sit in Slack for a day
“Talkers” with no results
Anyone scared of confrontation — this job requires directness
Bonus Points If You...
Have scaled operations for a DTC or logistics\-heavy business
Have used ERPs, Shopify, ShipHero, Gorgias, etc.
Understand how to balance margin vs. service
Know warehouse systems, ERPs, or Shopify backend ops
Can manage teams across time zones
Are calm under pressure — and ruthless with inefficiencies
What Success Looks Like
Customers never wait more than 24 hours for resolution
Weekly ops fires down to zero
Fulfillment issues drop by 90%
No launch delays due to operations
Staff are held accountable — and they know it
The business runs smoother — and your name is on it
How to Apply
Send us:
Your resume
A short paragraph: “Tell us about a process you overhauled that saved time or money.”
Bonus: Attach a real ops dashboard or report you’ve built

Versar is seeking a full\-time Project Manager (PM) to support physical Electronic Security System (ESS) installation projects nationwide in support of the United States Marshals Service (USMS). This includes, but is not limited to, verifying quality of installation and deliverables, evaluating percent complete for subcontracted tasks, evaluating equipment and materials used to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and standards, validating invoices for payment, negotiating costs, and managing scope change.

**Preferred Requirements:**

jobs.title: Publishing Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named \#2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

 **Job Summary**


The Publishing Onboarding Manager runs assigned publishing catalog transitions end to end, from deal handoff through steady\-state administration. Executes the standard onboarding playbook across catalog ingestion, registration, and works delivery to societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints, and owns the identification and redirection of rights and royalty streams for assigned catalogs. Serves as day\-to\-day operational contact for partners and sellers, coordinating with M\&A, Royalties, Business Affairs, and Legal throughout each transition. Reports to the Publishing Onboarding Director.

 **Responsibilities**

* Owns the operational onboarding of assigned catalogs end to end, from deal handoff through absorption into steady\-state administration and collection, executing the standard playbook at every stage.
* Turns deal diligence materials into a transition plan with named owners and deadlines within five business days of handoff, and keeps partners, sellers, and internal teams on schedule against it.
* Serves as the day\-to\-day operational contact for partners and sellers on assigned transitions, running onboarding calls, setting documentation expectations early, and escalating to the Director when partners are missing records or administrative know\-how.
* Executes catalog ingestion for assigned deals: validates schedules of works, identifiers (ISRC, IPI, ISWC), and ownership splits against deal schedules, and resolves metadata gaps and chain\-of\-title conflicts before works are registered and delivered.
* Executes registration and works delivery for assigned catalogs to societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints including YouTube, including CWR submission, acknowledgement processing, and remediation of non\-accepted works.
* Owns the identification, transfer, and redirection of rights and royalty streams in assigned catalogs, including US and CA PROs (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, SOCAN), mechanical and digital collections, and international collection.
* Liaises with the M\&A team on prior\-administrator wind\-down for assigned deals, which the M\&A team leads, ensuring pipeline income is captured and revenue leakage prevented during handover.
* Liaises with Royalties, Business Affairs, and/or Legal on third\-party payment obligations for assigned catalogs, including payee changes and account setup, ensuring these are initiated and completed on time during each transition.
* Manages several transitions at once, maintaining current per\-deal status in Atlas and checking in with stakeholders on a frequent informal cadence between formal reviews.
* Delivers per\-deal status, risk, registration completeness, and pipeline income capture for assigned transitions into the monthly reporting package, attributing recovered and pipeline income to the onboarding actions that produced it.
* Executes the standard playbook as written and feeds gaps, exceptions, and deal variance back to the Director, who owns the playbook and its improvement.
* Documents new procedures as SOPs at the point of first execution, and surfaces manual steps, workflow gaps, and data quality risks across assigned transitions for prioritization.
* Supports pre\-closing review for deals in diligence, applying the pre\-close checklist so incoming deals land onboarding\-ready.
* Keeps Business Affairs, M\&A, Legal, Finance, Royalties, Digital Rights, and Data \& Analytics informed on assigned transitions, escalating decisions to the Director.
* Stays current on society delivery requirements, CWR versions, and identifier standards as they affect assigned catalogs.
* Supports the Director with special projects and deal\-related analysis as needed.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* 4\+ years in music publishing administration, with direct experience taking catalogs from acquisition or agreement through registration and delivery
* Hands\-on catalog ingestion: validating works, writers, splits, and identifiers against deal schedules
* Registration and delivery to PROs, mechanical societies, sub\-publishers, and digital endpoints
* Managing multiple concurrent transitions or catalog projects with external counterparties
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience, plus 4\+ years in music publishing administration including direct experience onboarding catalogs — taking works from acquisition or agreement through registration and delivery to societies and digital endpoints.
* CWR delivery and acknowledgement processing, including diagnosing and remediating non\-accepted works
* Working knowledge of identifier standards — ISWC, IPI, ISRC — and how they behave across systems
* US and Canadian PRO workflows (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, SOCAN) plus mechanical and digital collection paths
* Chain\-of\-title and split\-conflict resolution
* Advanced spreadsheet work on large catalog datasets; comfort with publishing admin systems
* Direct partner\- and seller\-facing communication, including holding counterparties to documentation deadlines

As the Project Manager, you will oversee end\-to\-end execution, sprint planning, and workflow governance across all six pillars of our Digital department: Software Development, Product Management, Design, Business Intelligence, Digital Marketing, and IT. Working directly under the Director of Technology, you will translate strategic directives into structured execution roadmaps, optimize cross\-functional intake processes, and keep multi\-disciplinary projects moving on deadline.

You will serve as the central operational engine—eliminating execution bottlenecks, aligning internal teams and contractors, and providing transparent reporting to executive leadership to ensure our technology stack scales predictably and efficiently.

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Please refer to our Compensation section below to see what neighborhoods fall under each Zone.


### **Role Description**


Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager, Customers to build the connective layer between EPD and GTM as we test products, evolve the platform, and learn from our managed customer base. This role will plan, recruit, launch, engage, measure, and close out customer programs while maintaining clear product\-readiness standards and a strong customer experience.


The role is execution\-focused but broad in scope. The immediate priority is creating a scalable way to test pre\-PMF products with existing managed customers, including priority programs. Over time, the role will support additional customer\-facing EPD initiatives, help relaunch and operate Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board, integrate customer testing into launch processes, and establish repeatable playbooks that can be adopted by functional owners.


You will work closely with Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics. You will have substantial cross\-functional exposure and the opportunity to turn customer participation into clearer product decisions, stronger launch readiness, and a closed insight loop back into product and GTM.


### **Responsibilities**


* Stand up and run repeatable customer programs, including planning, recruitment, onboarding, engagement, measurement, closeout, and transition to the long\-term owning team.
* Create shared operating infrastructure, including intake processes, recruitment and readiness criteria, briefs, templates, playbooks, status reporting, feedback tracking, escalation paths, and a single source of truth.
* Coordinate Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics around shared plans, decisions, milestones, and handoffs.
* Own the execution of pre\-PMF customer testing through H2, including product evaluation, messaging feedback, phased\-rollout support, measurement, and exit criteria.
* Support the relaunch and ongoing operation of Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board through recruitment, cadence management, agenda design, and synthesis for senior leaders and partner teams.
* Integrate customer testing into the product\-launch process as a readiness gate or stage, partnering with PMM and Launch Ops as the process matures.
* Establish recurring customer listening and insight\-loop practices that connect customer\-support signals, VoC, UXR, managed\-customer feedback, and S\-team engagement back into EPD and GTM decision\-making.

### **Requirements**


* 8\+ years of program management, operations, customer research operations, product operations, go\-to\-market operations, or a related field with experience delivering complex cross\-functional programs.
* Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer\-facing initiative from planning through execution, measurement, closeout, and handoff.
* Experience coordinating multiple teams with different goals, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining clear ownership and follow\-through.
* Strong operating discipline: able to create practical processes, readiness criteria, documentation, reporting rhythms, and repeatable playbooks.
* Experience working directly with customers or customer\-facing teams, including recruiting participants, managing engagement, gathering feedback, and protecting customer experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Sound judgment about product readiness, customer participation, confidentiality, escalation, and when to protect learning quality over premature storytelling or account\-driven requests.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with pre\-PMF product testing, beta or Design Partner programs, Customer Advisory Boards, Voice of Customer, user research operations, or customer advocacy programs.
* Experience embedding customer feedback or testing into product\-launch, launch\-readiness, or product\-operations processes.
* Experience building a program that scales across products, customer segments, or launch types and then transitioning it to a durable functional owner.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - O&M
jobs.description:
**Posting Title:** Assistant Project Manager \- O\&M
**Reports To:** Senior O\&M Specialist**Location:** Hybrid or Remote**Salary Range:** $82,000 to $106,000
* ***This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.***


This position primarily involves working remotely or in an office.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS***Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.***Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.
**Experience:** Three (3\) or more years of experience specifically as a Project Engineer in electrical construction (Renewable Energy preferred) or MEP/Civil/Structural experience in general contracting. Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.

**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**


The Program Manager, Academics supports the implementation and continuous improvement of K12's portfolio\-wide academic strategy. Working closely with the Director, Academic Strategy, this role translates strategic priorities into effective processes, tools, resources, communications, and supports that help schools strengthen academic practice and student outcomes.  

The Program Manager plays a key role in managing the K12 School Playbook process, analyzing implementation and performance information, identifying trends and effective practices across schools, and supporting the development and adoption of scalable academic solutions. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong academic knowledge, analytical thinking, project management, and the ability to coordinate complex work across teams and schools.**Essential Functions:** Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

* Support implementation of K12's academic strategy by translating priorities into plans, processes, tools, resources, and school\-facing supports.
* Manage key components of the annual K12 School Playbook process, including timelines, templates, guidance, communications, review workflows, documentation, and follow\-up.
* Support review of school Playbooks to promote quality, coherence, and alignment with K12 expectations.
* Coordinate the Playbook review and feedback process, track required revisions and emerging themes, and support consistent application of established quality standards.
* Analyze Playbooks, implementation evidence, academic performance, engagement, graduation, and accountability data to identify common strengths, challenges, and opportunities across schools.
* Synthesize findings across schools and help identify, document, and share effective and evidence\-informed practices that can be scaled across the portfolio.
* Develop and maintain academic frameworks, implementation guides, tools, exemplars, resources, and other materials that support strong Tier 1 academic practices and consistent execution.
* Support implementation and monitoring of academic initiatives, identify implementation barriers, and recommend adjustments based on data and school feedback.
* Partner with school and portfolio leaders to gather feedback, understand implementation needs, and support effective adoption of academic priorities and practices.
* Develop and coordinate professional learning, communications, and resources related to academic strategy, the School Playbook, and priority academic practices.
* Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination for assigned academic initiatives.
* Collaborate with Accountability, Assessment, Research, Curriculum and Instruction, School Services, Transformation, Special Programs, School Counseling, Career Readiness, and other teams to support aligned implementation.
* Prepare analyses, summaries, presentations, and recommendations for the Director, Academic Strategy and other leaders related to academic performance, Playbook implementation, emerging trends, and strategic initiatives.
* Support continuous improvement by monitoring implementation and outcomes, gathering stakeholder feedback, and recommending improvements to academic processes, tools, and supports.

 **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Minimum Required** **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in education, curriculum and instruction, educational leadership, or a related field.
* Five (5\) or more years of related experience in K–12 education, instructional leadership, academic programs, school support, project or program management, or a related field; OR
* Equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience using academic or student performance data to identify trends and support decision\-making.

**Certificates and Licenses**: None required.

**Other Required Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of effective K–12 instructional practices and systems supporting student academic success.
* Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative information, identify patterns, and translate findings into clear recommendations and resources.
* Strong project and program management skills, including managing timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to develop clear, practical tools, guidance, resources, and communications for school or instructional audiences.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain quality and consistency across complex processes and deliverables.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and organizational levels and influence without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Strong organizational skills, initiative, and results orientation in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in education, curriculum and instruction, educational leadership, or a related field.
* Experience as a teacher, instructional coach, school leader, or district/network academic staff member.
* Experience in virtual education.
* Experience supporting schools across multiple locations or states.
* Experience with school academic planning, instructional frameworks, continuous improvement processes, or implementation monitoring.
* Knowledge of state accountability systems, academic performance measures, assessment, MTSS, and graduation outcomes.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Lead, Enterprise Clinical Informatics \& AI Programs to lead the execution and scaling of AI\-enabled clinical informatics initiatives, with an initial focus on Ambient AI Scribe capabilities across federal healthcare environments. This role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end program delivery, aligning clinical, technical, and operational stakeholders, and ensuring successful adoption of solutions that improve provider experience, clinical workflows, and care delivery outcomes.  

This position will be fully remote and will operate at the enterprise level, coordinating multiple workstreams and cross\-functional teams. The Lead serves as the primary authority for program execution, responsible for portfolio\-level delivery, Program Increment (PI) planning alignment, and ensuring measurable value across all contributing teams. This role generally reports to a Program Manager.
Responsibilities:
* Leads enterprise\-level clinical informatics and AI\-enabled programs, including oversight and scaling of Ambient AI Scribe capabilities across healthcare environments.
* Oversees program execution across multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment of clinical, technical, and operational stakeholders.
* Directs Program Increment (PI) planning, coordination, and delivery within SAFe\-aligned environments to support continuous value delivery.
* Manages cross\-functional teams comprised of multidisciplinary staff, including clinical, engineering, data, and operations personnel.
* Establishes and maintains integrated program plans, including scope, schedule, resource coordination, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Monitors program performance, budgets, and timelines; provides executive\-level reporting and ensures alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identifies program risks and issues; develops mitigation strategies and facilitates resolution to support program success and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Drives clinical workflow optimization by translating operational needs into scalable informatics\-enabled solutions.
* Leads stakeholder engagement across program offices, clinical leadership, and external partners to ensure alignment, usability, and adoption.
* Oversees coordination of vendor and partner activities, ensuring deliverables align with program objectives and quality standards.
* Defines program requirements and guides lifecycle coordination across design, validation, and operational use phases.
* Ensures adherence to quality, safety, and performance standards for clinical informatics and digital health capabilities.
* Coordinates across teams to manage dependencies, improve communication, and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes.
* Supports strategic planning, analysis, and capture activities for enterprise healthcare informatics initiatives.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) with 12\+ years of progressive experience in clinical informatics, healthcare program management, or digital health transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-level programs across multiple workstreams, including coordination of clinical, technical, and operational stakeholders.
* Proven experience operating in federal healthcare environments (VA, DoD, or large integrated health systems).
* Experience supporting AI\-enabled or data\-driven clinical solutions, including evaluation, workflow integration, or scaling of capabilities such as clinical documentation tools.
* Strong understanding of EHR ecosystems, including VistA/CPRS and/or Oracle Health (Cerner), and their impact on clinical workflows.
* Experience leading or supporting SAFe or Agile delivery models, including Program Increment (PI) planning, backlog coordination, and cross\-team dependency management.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior clinical, operational, and program leadership to drive alignment and adoption.
* Experience managing program performance, risk, and delivery across complex, matrixed environments.
* Ability to translate clinical and operational needs into scalable informatics\-enabled solutions.
* Clearance Level: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or higher clearance.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience supporting or scaling Ambient AI Scribe or similar AI\-enabled clinical documentation solutions.
* Prior experience working with or supporting VA Office of Connected Care, Office of Clinical Informatics, or Digital Health Office initiatives.
* Experience leading clinical workflow optimization or provider burden reduction initiatives.
* Familiarity with health data standards and interoperability frameworks (HL7, FHIR, SNOMED, LOINC).
* Experience supporting enterprise transformation or portfolio\-level informatics initiatives within large healthcare organizations.
* Certifications such as SAFe Agilist (SA), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), PMP, or Prosci Change Management.
* Advanced degree in health informatics, healthcare administration, public health, or related field.

**Clearance Required**: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
Posted Salary Range: USD $170,000\.00 \- USD $190,000\.00 /Yr.

Goldbelt Glacier is a trusted industry partner to the Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). Goldbelt Glacier supports programs administered through the BIA including social services, natural resources management, economic development, law enforcement and detention services, administration of tribal courts, implementation of land and water claim settlements, housing improvement, disaster relief, replacement and repair of schools, repair and maintenance of roads and bridges, and the repair of structural deficiencies on high hazard dams. **Summary:**  

Goldbelt Glacier is seeking a Senior Program Manager to support the Indian Affairs Office of the Chief Financial Officer (OCFO). The Senior Program Manager will provide program management, analysis, process improvement, reporting, and implementation support across OCFO divisions.  

The position will work with OCFO leadership and staff to coordinate priorities and activities, identify and resolve operational issues, analyze data and performance, improve and standardize workflows, and support modernization and AI\-readiness efforts.  

Preference will be given to Alaska Native and/or American Indian applicants. **Location:** Remote/Contractor Site, with potential travel to on\-site locations as needed.

* Coordinate activities, priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues across multiple OCFO divisions.

* Support development and evaluation of AI and automation pilots, including requirements, test scripts, metrics, lessons learned, and recommended improvements.
* Assess AI readiness, including data availability, system constraints, workforce adoption, training needs, governance, and security considerations.
* Map current workflows and identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual steps, redundant approvals, inconsistent processes, and other inefficiencies.
* Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), playbooks, workflow maps, templates, quick\-reference guides, decision trees, and job aids.
* Support process improvements using approved tools such as SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
* Coordinate with OCFO stakeholders, system administrators, policy leads, and functional experts to support implementation of process improvements.
* Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and cross\-divisional coordination activities.
* Prepare executive\-level reports, briefings, memoranda, talking points, slide presentations, risk summaries, and decision\-support materials.

* Strategic planning and cross\-divisional coordination
* Problem identification, root\-cause analysis, and issue resolution

* Data analytics, dashboard development, and data visualization
* Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps
* AI use\-case development and AI\-readiness activities
* Workflow automation
* Process improvement and workflow mapping
* Developing SOPs, playbooks, templates, workflow maps, and job aids
* Performance reporting and analysis
* Executive\-level reporting, briefings, and communications
* Federal process improvement and compliance requirements
* Audit readiness and modernization initiatives
* FBMS, S4HANA, and SharePoint

jobs.title: SPMO Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Join the People Helping People**
==================================

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.


**Basic Function**

This position directs Project Management efforts to successfully implement change in timely and efficient manner. Incumbent will manage highly complex projects and will establish and direct efforts of the project team and related resources to successfully plan, develop, test, and implement assigned projects. Incumbent will assume total leadership for assigned events on behalf of Sponsor, and are responsible for project organization, planning, and issue resolution.


**Essential Functions \& Responsibilities**

* Provide project management expertise, which includes leading various highly complex projects.
* Meet with business unit leadership and various stakeholders to review and determine project requirements, and necessary specifications, plans for testing, support, and training, and established timeline and budget.
* Manage projects utilizing Velera project management standards; Manage utilizing Agile, Waterfall and other methodologies as required.
* Coordinate completion of various integration elements of assigned projects, to include project plan development and execution, and overall change control; develop project plans to include full project scope/charter from initiation, work\-breakdown structure, planning, definition, verification, and change control.
* Ensure projects are completed within established time and budget schedules, including activity definition, activity sequencing, and activity duration estimations; ensure completion of resource planning, cost estimations, and cost budgeting and control; monitor and manage the critical path; manage scope, timeline, resources and financial aspect.
* Ensure projects satisfy needs for which they were undertaken by including quality planning, assurance, and control; Ensure people chosen for project team are used most effectively through organizational planning, staff acquisition, and team development.
* Provide proactive communication to project stakeholders related to projects, their risks, and steps being taken to mitigate these risks.
* Partner with Team members to develop effective resolution to project issues; collect and monitor service performance rating on issue resolution to ensure compliance with set standards.
* Monitor the progress of all change events and assist in the resolution of issues and delays impacting the successful conclusion of the project.
* Monitor, control, update, and coordinate changes to existing programs and projects; Provide reports summarizing project status to project stakeholders; manage all project documentation including status reports, project charter/scope, risks, RACI, change request, project close, action items, issues list, lessons learned and health; maintain up\-to\-date project schedule and status using Velera approved tools; track defects and resolution through sprints or project phases.
* Critique completed projects to determine variations from established processes and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Serve as project lead on projects with multiple project management staff.
* Resolve issues arising from requests to change business specifications or defined tasks.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Physical Demands**

* While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.
* Ability to occasionally lift/move up to 25 pounds.
* Individuals with a disability who are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job may request a reasonable accommodation through the Human Resources department.

**Other Physical Demands**

* None

**Supervisory Responsibility**

* None

jobs.description:
### **Please be aware of recruiting scams!**


All legitimate communication from our recruitment team will come from an official calstart.org email address via email, we will not text you about a role you have not applied to or shown interest in. We will not perform any interviews via text or Zoom chat.

CALSTART does not ask for any fees or personal information such as social security numbers or bank details during the recruitment process.

**About Us**:

CALSTART is a mission\-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.



For over 30 years, it’s been CALSTART’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large\-scale, zero\-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real\-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

  


### **About The Role:**



The OEMs \& Equipment Project Manager supports CALSTART's Dealer Training \& Engagement Team by managing vehicle, equipment, manufacturer, and dealer related activities across the on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs administered by CALSTART. Reporting to the Deputy Director of Dealer Training \& Engagement, this role works closely with original equipment manufacturers, dealers, internal program teams, and government partners to coordinate vehicle and equipment additions, updates, removals, deactivations, eligibility changes, dealer affiliations, and other catalog related functions. The position helps ensure that program systems, public facing information, and internal records remain accurate, current, and aligned with program requirements.



The ideal candidate brings experience with commercial vehicles, zero emission technologies, or on and off road equipment, along with strong project management, data management, analytical, and communication skills. Daily responsibilities include tracking approval and eligibility documentation, maintaining records in Salesforce and website authoring platforms, analyzing vehicle and equipment data, preparing reports, supporting process improvements, and developing clear procedures for recurring workflows. This role will also help streamline and automate vehicle and equipment intake, year end vehicle deactivation, OEM notifications, reporting, and related administrative processes. The position offers an opportunity to work directly with emerging clean transportation technologies, build productive relationships with manufacturers and dealers, and improve the systems and processes that support transition to zero emission vehicles and equipment.


### **Duties \& Responsibilities:**


* Manage vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer related workflows across CALSTART administered on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs, including additions, removals, deactivations, eligibility updates, dealer affiliations, and other program changes.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for original equipment manufacturers and participating dealers, providing clear, accurate, and timely communication regarding program processes, documentation requirements, system updates, and next steps.
* Review and track vehicle and equipment approval or eligibility documentation, coordinate required follow up, and ensure information is accurately reflected across Salesforce, public facing websites, internal tracking tools, and related program systems.
* Lead projects to standardize, streamline, and document recurring OEM and equipment workflows, including approval letter intake, catalog updates, OEM notifications, year end vehicle deactivation, and dealer or manufacturer change processes.
* Maintain and analyze vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer data to identify trends, monitor workflow status, support decision making, and prepare recurring or ad hoc reports for program leadership and internal partners.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates, trackers, and training materials that improve accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and continuity across Voucher Incentive Programs.
* Partner with the Dealer Training \& Engagement Team to translate policy, equipment, and system changes into clear guidance, training resources, and communications for dealers and OEM representatives.
* Collaborate closely with Voucher Processing, Policy, Technology, Data \& Analytics, Marketing and Communications, program leadership, and government agency partners to resolve issues and ensure coordinated implementation of program changes.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve data quality through automation, system enhancements, and improved use of platforms such as Salesforce, website authoring software, Monday.com, and other program management tools.
* Support the successful launch and ongoing administration of new Voucher Incentive Programs, vehicle categories, equipment types, technologies, and program requirements by coordinating readiness activities across internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and time sensitive requests while maintaining organized records, clear priorities, dependable follow through, and consistent communication with stakeholders.
* Contribute to organizational goals by improving the accuracy of public facing program information, strengthening OEM and dealer relationships, reducing processing delays, and supporting the adoption of zero emission vehicles and equipment.

### **Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in transportation, engineering, environmental studies, business administration, public policy, project management, data analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* At least five years of relevant experience

jobs.title: Partner Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!


**More about our team and company:**

  
**About the Role**



Fleetio is looking for a Partner Enablement Manager to build and run the programs that make our reseller partners — Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), telematics providers, and VARs — genuinely effective at selling, implementing, and supporting Fleetio. This is a program\-management\-first role with a strong enablement mandate: you'll own the full onboarding curriculum for new partners and, just as importantly, you'll be the reason existing partners stay current as Fleetio's product, pricing, and messaging evolve. Enablement here isn't a one\-time event — it's an ongoing operating rhythm.



You'll be the connective tissue between our reseller partners and Fleetio's internal functions — Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support — translating what's changing inside Fleetio into what partners need to know, do, or say differently, and translating what partners need back into clear asks for the right internal team.


**What You'll Do**


* Own and run structured onboarding programs for newly signed reseller partners, covering technical/platform onboarding, sales training, value\-selling methodology, and partner marketing enablement — able to run multiple onboarding cohorts concurrently without dropping details.
* Build and maintain the partner enablement curriculum: onboarding tracks, certification/training materials, playbooks, battlecards, and value\-selling frameworks tailored to each partner type (FMC, telematics, VAR).
* Establish an ongoing enablement cadence beyond onboarding — proactively pushing updates to partner\-facing teams whenever there's a platform release, new feature, pricing/packaging change, or updated marketing messaging, so partners are never selling or supporting an outdated version of Fleetio.
* Act as the internal conduit for partner enablement needs: gather requirements from partners, route them to the right function (Product, Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support), and close the loop once addressed.
* Partner closely with the Partner Account Management team to identify enablement gaps surfaced through partner health, ramp speed, or performance data, and build programs to close them.
* Enhance and maintain partner\-facing training content and documentation (onboarding guides, LMS content, recorded trainings, quick\-reference materials) in a consistent, on\-brand format.
* Track and report on enablement effectiveness — onboarding completion/time\-to\-ramp, training engagement, certification rates — and use that data to continuously improve programs.

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**


**OUR COMPANY**


SimX is a fast\-growing company bringing virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional\-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors.


Since our product became generally available, demand has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation's top 15 hospitals, including world\-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania. Additionally, our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military bases. We are looking for a mission\-driven leader to help us continue this momentum and save lives through better training.


**THE JOB**


The Customer Success Manager owns a portfolio of customers and is responsible for onboarding, retention, expansion, and long\-term adoption of SimX's platform. We are looking for a collaborative and highly engaged Customer Success Manager to drive revenue growth across a set of existing customers while looking for ways to enhance the customer journey post\-sale. If you are a strong communicator \& negotiator, have an ownership mindset, and enjoy building relationships with your customers, then we invite you to apply.


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


### **Customer Relationship \& Success**


* **Trusted Partnership**: Develop deep, trusted relationships within accounts to serve as a primary point of contact and advisor.
* **Success Planning**: Partner with customers to define clear success criteria and conduct regular "Business Reviews" to ensure their goals are being met.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**: Work closely with Educational Services to develop account strategies and ensure a seamless experience across the customer journey.


### **Product \& Technical Expertise**


* **Technical Onboarding:** Lead comprehensive virtual and in\-person onboarding, training (including VR hardware/software setup), and refresher sessions for new and key clients.
* **Roadmap Alignment**: Support and drive customer understanding of the SimX product roadmap, recommending creative ways to maximize product utilization.
* **Cross\-Department Collaboration:** Work with the customer support and educational services team to provide prompt, thorough support to clients during onboarding, and attend/support critical in\-person training events and exercises.


### **Sales \& Revenue Strategy**


* **Ownership of the Post\-Sale Journey**: Own, drive, and manage the complete customer journey from onboarding to renewal to ensure high retention and satisfaction.
* **Revenue Growth**: Drive retention and expansion within your accounts through strong adoption, value realization, and strategic account planning.
* **Risk Mitigation**: Proactively maintain the book of business, identifying and communicating any retention risks to internal resources to develop effective resolution strategies.
* **Commercial Management**: Lead multiple customer touchpoints by engaging key stakeholders and managing the commercial aspects of the account.


### **Operations \& Reporting**


* **Process Improvement**: Assist in developing and improving internal processes to make the post\-sale team more effective and efficient.
* **Data Integrity**: Manage, track, and report all sales and success activities using Salesforce to ensure accurate data for the organization.
* **Usage Tracking:** Track monthly usage of customers, identify high\-use and low\-use customers, and develop strategies in partnership with Educational Services for driving greater platform adoption and utilization.


**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**


* 2 \- 4 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar customer\-facing role within SaaS or similar.
* Strong track record of managing a book of business with retention and/or expansion targets
* Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce or equivalent) as well as office software like Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Consultative selling experience resulting in growing existing accounts
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Proof of eligibility to work in the United States
* Permanent residence in the United States
* Willingness to travel 10\-15% for work


**This is a full\-time, remote position. Candidates must live within the United States. I**n addition, candidates will also be expected to attend major simulation conferences and/or in\-person meetings, potentially as frequently as monthly.

Note: these are not required to be a successful applicant, but we'd love it if you have one or two! Please also feel free to let us know if you have skills not listed here that you think would make you a great fit for our company.


* Professional experience in the healthcare industry (RN, EMT, Paramedic, PA, MD, DO, etc.)
* Professional experience in military/government (Active Duty, Former Duty, etc)
* Experience working with a sales team in a remote work environment.
* Experience with VR hardware and/or software.
* Degree in business, healthcare administration, or related field.


**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

* Remote work environment

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

At Segment, we believe companies should be able to send their data wherever they want, whenever they want, with no fuss. We make this easy with a single platform that collects, stores, filters, transforms, and sends data to hundreds of business tools with the flip of a switch. More recently, we also developed the ability to let customers enrich their data in real time using computations they specify. Our goal is to make it easy to understand, extract value, and protect the integrity of data. jobs.title: Lab Visit Support Lead
jobs.description:
US \- Remote
Member Experience
Remote
Full\-time
### **About Us**

  

  

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

### **The Role**

  

  

We are seeking a **Lab Visit Support Lead** to own the day\-to\-day operations and performance of an LVS team (“POD”) of approximately 10 Member Support Agents. This role sits at the center of frontline execution: ensuring work is prioritized effectively, staffing and workflows are adjusted in real time, escalations are resolved quickly, and the team consistently delivers a high\-quality member experience.  

  

Lab Visit Support (LVS) is the team responsible for providing real\-time support to Function members on the day of their lab visit, whether at a Quest location or during a mobile phlebotomy appointment. The team handles whatever comes up to keep visits on track—from check\-in and Quest navigation issues to same\-day lab order corrections, add\-on tests, scheduling changes, cancellations, test preparation questions, and system outages—all while managing live inboxes and phone lines in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

The LVS Lead is both an **operational leader and people manager**. You will directly manage MSAs and Senior MSAs, providing real\-time coaching, performance feedback, development, and accountability while ensuring the team meets its daily operational goals. You’ll empower Senior MSAs to serve as frontline resources while stepping in on complex escalations, critical errors, or situations requiring leadership judgment.  

  

You will work in close partnership with the LVS Manager, serving as their primary source of visibility into frontline performance, emerging trends, and operational friction. While the Manager focuses on longer\-term strategy, workforce planning, performance trends, and scalable improvements, the Lead owns the **daily execution and decisions that keep the team performing at a high level today**.  

  

*Given that Lab Visit Support operates Monday–Sunday across multiple time zones, this role will periodically require weekend and/or holiday on\-call coverage on a rotating schedule with other leaders.*  

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

  

  

* **Lead Day\-to\-Day Operations:** Own real\-time execution for your Lab Visit Support POD, ensuring work is prioritized, delegated, and completed effectively while stepping in to resolve high\-impact issues and escalations.
* **Manage \& Develop the Team:** Directly manage MSAs and Senior MSAs, providing ongoing coaching, feedback, performance management, and development while fostering a culture of accountability and growth.
* **Drive Team Performance:** Monitor productivity, quality, adherence, and other key performance indicators, identifying performance gaps and taking action to ensure the team consistently meets expectations.
* **Own Real\-Time Staffing \& Scheduling:** Manage day\-to\-day staffing and workload allocation, including schedules, coverage, overtime, time off, and adjustments based on changing member demand.
* **Ensure Quality \& Operational Excellence:** Partner with Senior MSAs to maintain high quality standards, address critical errors and recurring coaching themes, and ensure consistent adherence to established processes.
* **Lead Escalation Management:** Serve as the leadership point of contact for complex or high\-priority member and operational escalations, supporting Senior MSAs and making timely decisions to keep lab visits on track.
* **Support Onboarding \& Training:** Oversee the onboarding and ramp of new team members, partnering with Senior MSAs to ensure new hires develop the knowledge, judgment, and confidence needed to operate independently.
* **Identify \& Drive Improvements:** Surface trends, workflow inefficiencies, documentation gaps, and tooling opportunities, owning day\-to\-day improvements and partnering with the Manager on broader operational initiatives.
* **Partner Cross\-Functionally:** Collaborate with teams across Member Experience and Operations to investigate issues, improve workflows, and ensure a seamless member experience.
* **Provide Operational Insights:** Maintain close partnership with the LVS Manager, surfacing frontline performance, staffing, quality, and member\-experience insights that inform broader workforce planning and team strategy.
* **Build Team Culture:** Lead regular team touchpoints and create an environment of strong communication, collaboration, accountability, and connection to Function’s mission.

**What You'll Do:**

  

We're seeking a **Revenue Enablement Manager \- GTM Readiness \& Adoption** to support onboarding, enablement, readiness, and adoption initiatives across our global Go\-to\-Market (GTM)organization.  

  



This role will partner with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, Product Marketing, Product Enablement, and business leaders to execute learning experiences, change readiness activities, onboarding programs, communications, and reinforcement plans that help employees successfully adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.  

  



The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, data\-driven, and passionate about helping teams learn, adapt, and perform at their best.


**This role is 100% work from home role within the United States.**  

  

**Responsibilities:**  



**GTM Readiness \& Adoption Planning**

* Build readiness, enablement, communication, and reinforcement plans that support adoption of strategic GTM initiatives.
* Translate launch priorities into role\-based learning journeys, manager tools, stakeholder communications, and adoption checkpoints.
* Partner with GTM Transformation, RevOps, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, and Revenue Leadership to ensure teams are prepared for change.

**AI\-Enabled Workflow Adoption**

* Enable GTM teams to use AI\-assisted workflows across reporting, pipeline inspection, day planning, prioritization, and customer\-facing communication.
* Partner with RevOps and GTM Transformation to embed AI guidance into existing tools, workflows, and enablement moments.
* Define adoption and effectiveness measures that connect AI usage to productivity, ramp, workflow consistency, and enablement engagement.

**Organizational Readiness \& Adoption**

* Develop readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement plans, launch criteria, and adoption strategies for major GTM initiatives.
* Identify adoption risks and organizational barriers, then proactively define mitigation plans.
* Create role\-based reinforcement plans that help employees and managers sustain new behaviors after launch.

**Enablement and Learning Experiences**

* Design onboarding and enablement programs using modern learning modalities, including instructor\-led, virtual, micro\-learning, self\-paced, cohort\-based, and experiential learning.
* Align onboarding to competency frameworks, role expectations, and time\-to\-productivity goals.
* Use business priorities, learner feedback, and adoption data to continuously improve enablement experiences.

**Sustainment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Establish reinforcement strategies, leadership checkpoints, feedback loops, and inspection mechanisms that sustain adoption after launch.
* Monitor initiative health and recommend improvements based on adoption data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, learning and development, onboarding, organizational development, change management, customer success enablement, or a related field.
* Experience supporting onboarding, training, communication, or adoption initiatives.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience using learning technologies, digital learning tools, or AI\-enabled productivity solutions.
* Strong attention to detail and execution focus.

**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**

* Experience supporting global or geographically distributed GTM organizations.
* Background in organizational readiness, change management frameworks, or large\-scale adoption initiatives.
* Experience enabling adoption of AI, CRM, sales, customer success, or revenue technology workflows.
Strong partnership with GTM Transformation, Product Marketing, Product Enablement, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations teams.  
* 

  

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  

  

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! The ICC identifies and brings together family, natural supports (friends, extended family, neighbors, community members) and formal system partners (child welfare, school, juvenile probation, etc.) to form a Child \& Family Team (CFT) which collectively works together to address goals and ensure successful and enduring change.

new_jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------



The Sales Operations Manager serves as the day\-to\-day execution partner to the Head of Sales Operations, translating commercial priorities into reliable systems, data, workflows, and cross\-functional execution across every sales channel (DTC, wholesale, corporate/customization, marketplaces, and key accounts).



The right candidate combines systems aptitude with strong operational judgment. They are comfortable moving between supporting an ERP implementation, a fulfillment exception, a product\-launch checklist, a ticketing automation, a pricing audit, and trade\-show logistics—while maintaining accuracy, ownership, and follow\-through.



As part of a lean, growing company, this role also includes hands\-on administrative and coordination responsibilities. The successful candidate must be comfortable balancing strategic projects and systems work with the detailed day\-to\-day tasks required to keep operations organized and moving forward.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


* **Systems Administration \& Tech Stack:** Oversee day\-to\-day administration, integrations, and performance for ERP, Shopify, 3PL platforms, customer service tools, marketplaces, and reporting systems.
* **Technical Requirements \& Testing:** Translate business needs into user stories, process maps, and data mappings. Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), defect tracking, and release readiness with developers and vendors.
* **Troubleshooting \& Documentation:** Investigate workflow and data failures to resolution while maintaining comprehensive integration maps and SOPs.
* **Omnichannel Data Governance:** Manage SKU setup, product attributes, pricing, tags, and fulfillment logic across all channels to ensure cross\-platform data integrity.
* **GTM \& Launch Orchestration:** Act as operational liaison for go\-to\-market execution, aligning cross\-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Fulfillment) on timelines, dependencies, and launch readiness.
* **Sales \& Channel Enablement:** Equip sales reps and external retail partners with price sheets, collateral, samples, assets, and product data.
* **Fulfillment \& Warehouse Operations:** Coordinate daily operations with 3PLs and warehouses, actively tracking aging orders, inventory discrepancies, transfers, and shipping exceptions.
* **Customer Experience Optimization:** Administer CS ticketing systems, live chat, routing rules, and automated workflows.
* **Trade Show \& Event Logistics:** Support full\-scope event operations with the Sales Director, including booth service orders, budget tracking, freight delivery, material handling, and storage.

**The experience you'll bring**
-------------------------------


#### **Required:**


* 4\+ years of progressive experience in sales operations, business systems, fulfillment operations, or a comparable cross\-functional role.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business\-software implementations, integrations, migrations, or major workflow changes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers, implementation consultants, and software vendors to translate technical details into business impact.
* Working knowledge of omnichannel order management, fulfillment, inventory, shipping, SKU setup, pricing, and launch operations.
* Self\-starter capable of managing multiple workstreams and external partners with limited oversight.
* **Location:** Remote\-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co\-working options available in Bozeman, MT, San Rafael, CA, or Golden, CO (our three office hubs).
* **Travel Requirements:** 2 team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips as needed (e.g., fulfillment center visits, trade shows).

#### **Preferred:**


* Hands\-on experience with Shopify Plus, ERP, WMS/3PL integrations, ticketing/live\-chat platforms, CRM tools, BI/reporting platforms, or marketplace channels.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, EDI, middleware, data mapping, UAT, and change\-management processes.
* Background in consumer products, retail, wholesale, or e\-commerce.

**Salary and benefits**
-----------------------


* Expected base salary range:$80k\-$110k.Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.
* Eligible for bi\-annual performance bonus and annual company bonus
* Unlimited PTO and 13 paid holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) with up to 5% company match
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Remote\-first

**Additional details**
----------------------



High Camp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance for this role.

*Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.*


  
**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


People Operations is taking on more complex, cross\-functional program work as Harvey grows globally — from opening new entities and markets, to integrating acquisitions, to evolving the systems and providers that support our employees around the world. These programs span People, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams, and need a dedicated owner who can bring the whole thing together.


You’ll run point on these initiatives end\-to\-end: defining requirements, building the plan, driving decisions and execution across teams, and making sure we’re ready to go live. This is a hands\-on program management role — you’ll work closely with functional experts, but you’re expected to get into the substance, develop a point of view, and personally execute work wherever needed to drive the program forward.


**What You'll Do**
==================


* **Own complex global programs from scope through go\-live and handoff**, including new entity formation and geographic expansion, M\&A integrations, and the ongoing evolution of our infrastructure in existing markets — such as EOR and vendor transitions, payroll migrations, and other major operational changes.
* **Build and drive the program plan**, translating a messy objective into clear requirements, workstreams, owners, dependencies, readiness gates, and decisions; proactively surface risks, resolve blockers, and adjust the plan as facts change.
* **Connect the dots across functions.** Partner deeply with People Ops, People Systems, Finance, Payroll, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams to understand how decisions in one workstream affect another and make sure nothing falls between the cracks.
* **Own program communication and change management**, from crisp executive updates and decision points to clear, thoughtful communications for employees affected by a change.
* **Build repeatable infrastructure as we scale**, turning what we learn from each program into better templates, SOPs, playbooks, and operating processes for the next one.
* **Keep the employee experience at the center.** Make sure operational complexity behind the scenes translates into a coordinated, thoughtful experience for employees — particularly during high\-change moments like entering a new market, transitioning employment infrastructure, or integrating an acquired team.

**What You Have**
=================


* 7\+ years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs, with experience in global People infrastructure such as geographic expansion, entity formation, M\&A integration, or related work.
* A hands\-on operating style and strong bias toward action. You dig into the substance, step into gaps, and do what’s needed to keep complex work moving. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and have good judgment about what requires deeper diligence versus what simply needs to get done.
* Strong stakeholder management and judgment, with the ability to align specialists and senior leaders across functions without formal authority.
* Clear, direct executive communication. You can distill a complicated program into the decisions, risks, and tradeoffs that matter and communicate them appropriately to everyone from executives to affected employees.
* Strong AI fluency. You use AI as a core part of how you work — to move faster, synthesize information, work through ambiguity, and increase the quality and leverage of your output.

**Compensation**
================


$120,000 \- $200,000 USD
